paragraphs: Zelix is an ultra-premium, production-ready React & Tailwind CSS web template meticulously crafted for AI startups, automation agencies, SaaS platforms, and modern enterprise software companies. Built with a sleek Obsidian & Glassmorphism design system, smooth Lenis scrolling, GSAP micro-interactions, and conversion-optimized components.
features: Obsidian & Glassmorphism Aesthetic: Modern dark/light styling, tailored color palettes, subtle glowing borders, and fluid backdrop blur effects.
Lenis Smooth Scroll & GSAP ScrollTrigger: Silky smooth 60fps wheel scrolling synchronized with GSAP animations.
Robust Client-Side SPA Navigation: Built-in client-side routing with smooth page entry/exit transitions and zero 404 reload issues on Vercel or other static hosts.
Home: Hero with live playground showcase, trusted partner marquee, feature grid, interactive process steps, ROI metrics, pricing toggle, testimonials, FAQ, and dual CTA.
